items.summary: Retain a report-only launch-readiness review for searchwoot.com. Evidence supports only a password-gated private preview with noindex/nofollow; public monetization is not approved. Owner must choose keep-private, bounded public beta, or full launch after confirming data-source rights and provenance, deal accuracy, privacy and consent treatment, terms, cookie/analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, platform policy, age or regulated-content implications if applicable, attribution, and rollback criteria. Human counsel should review privacy, consumer-disclosure, data-rights, and platform-policy questions before any public launch.
